title: What Remains in Passage | Alok Madan
description: A geography of thresholds, weather, and the light that outlives us.
intro: A geography of thresholds, weather, and the light that outlives us.
introDesktop: Every photograph is a door that closes at the instant it opens. It admits us into a fraction of light while withholding the life that surrounds it.
introMobile: A geography of thresholds, weather, and the light that outlives us.
contactBio: Alok Madan photographs cities as they are lived: through weather, transit, storefronts, monuments, and the people moving between them. The work begins with attention: what light reveals, what motion hides, and what remains after leaving.
contactRepresented: Based in New York. Available for editorial, cultural, and travel commissions, image licensing, and long-form collaborations.
